item.summary: improve(worker): diagnose admission-deadline failures and widen daemon revalidation budget (#130435) WorkerAdmissionDeadlineExceededError now carries the terminal diagnosis — the last connection failure kind and detail, attempt count, and the redacted endpoint — instead of a bare deadline sentence, and that text flows through IPC, container stderr, the node launch journal, and the gateway turn error. Credential material (raw, URL-encoded, JSON-escaped) is scrubbed before truncation. A LAN partition was misdiagnosed as a gateway admission wedge for a day because the old text was identical for never-connected and never-answered (#129979). Container daemon revalidation gets a 30s budget: a slammed-but-healthy OrbStack daemon exceeded the old 5s under a 50-container burst; fail-closed semantics unchanged.
